title: Adapt the existing EVA landing page in place
status: Part 1 free-upload refinement implemented and verified; publication pending. Parts 2–5 queued.
governingDirection: Evolve the existing landing, part by part. Preserve its runner, typography, photographs, Tasso film, dashboard/results mockup, halftone treatment, scroll choreography, and lifestyle imagery. Do not create another replacement landing, new audience tabs, new assets, or a new visual system.

confirmedOffer.priceUnit: At-home kit; do not invent a VAT rate, gross total, annual discount or recurring billing promise.

audiences.starting: Explain the value of a first test and help the customer understand the results.
audiences.alreadyTesting: Add context, comparable history and guided ownership of what to measure next.

confirmedOffer.futureChoice: Explain that the customer can explore available future panels with guidance. Do not imply that every panel or switch is included at €99.

collaboration.projectManager: Keep one bounded change list per part, verify the offer and sequence, and request review before advancing to the next part.
collaboration.copyExpert: Write into the existing text slots. Explain one idea at a time, using supported measurements and practical value. Speak to both audiences through ordinary copy rather than a new segmentation interface.
collaboration.masterDesigner: Fit the approved copy to the existing composition and motion. Adjust spacing and responsive type only where the new copy requires it.
collaboration.executor: Modify the existing components, preserve interaction behavior, collect phone and desktop evidence, and publish the concrete part for review.

parts.reviewMoment: Review the five adapted parts together, then scope sections6–9 separately.

sequencingRules: Only part1 is the immediate implementation scope. Do not implement the later parts as a surprise whole-page rewrite.
Each part receives copy review, design fit, browser checks and a concrete review link before the next part begins.
Use the same core facts across animated, static, mobile and accessible versions of each affected section.

Treat untouched historical15-marker,60-result and broader-panel copy as remaining work in the staged review. Clear those contradictions before presenting the completed landing to prospective customers as a final commercial offer.
Preserve detailed original information on supporting pages; the current task is to improve sequence and explanation rather than restore every historical sentence to the homepage.
finalAcceptance: A single recognizable EVA landing with its accepted animations and assets.
A clear progression: service → easy collection → useful results → exact kit → guided next step.
Exactly13 confirmed kit markers and €99 + VAT, with no invented tax total or future-panel inclusion.
Useful copy for both beginners and existing testers, without tabs or duplicated narratives.
Normal scrolling, accessible copy, native-speed film controls and a complete reduced-motion route.
No replacement page, new images, new animation system or unrequested changes to later sections.
